description: Somewhere wire.reach can go: this machine's host process, one listening on another socket, one over ssh, or a member of the mesh through this machine's.

path.description: unix: its socket; mesh: the host process it's reached through.

dest.description: ssh: where (an alias in ~/.ssh/config, a host, user@host); ssh runs HOST_COMMAND there.

strict.description: ssh: its key must be known already.
